text_blocks.snippet: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends that all children 6 months of age and older receive the COVID-19 vaccine series. The vaccine is safe and effective for children, and it can help protect them from serious illness, hospitalization, and death from COVID-19.

The COVID-19 vaccine is also important for children because it can help reduce the spread of the virus in their communities. When children are vaccinated, they are less likely to get infected and pass the virus on to others, including vulnerable individuals such as older adults and people with underlying health conditions.
Parents should discuss the benefits and risks of the COVID-19 vaccine with their healthcare provider to make an informed decision about vaccinating their children.
